{{Quote|Thank you so much!|C-3PO thanks the creature for the help|<ref name="Shiny" />}}
This '''four-armed creature''' was encountered by [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] when the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were stranded on a planet due to their [[Unidentified gold spacecraft|space vessel]] needing a new supply of [[space crystal]]s. The creature was covered in red fur, and had a round pink nose, yellow eyes and pointed ears. The creature emerged from the trees in a forest as the droids were looking for a cave containing replacement crystals. At Artoo's suggestion, C-3PO pet the hand of the creature, who then pointed the droid in the direction of the cave.<ref name="Shiny">''[[Shiny as a Droid: Things to See, Touch, and Smell from a Galaxy Far, Far Away]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Touch its paw and it will tell me where the cave is?|C-3PO in ''Shiny as a Droid'', addressing the reader|<ref name="Shiny" />}}
The creature appeared in [[Shiny as a Droid: Things to See, Touch, and Smell from a Galaxy Far, Far Away|''Shiny as a Droid'']], a [[1986]] children's book written by [[Virginia Holt]] and illustrated by [[Feito]]. The creature's paw is one of the interactive elements in the book that the reader can scratch.<ref name="Shiny" />
